methodology: Page-by-page pharmacology review in progress. Status updated means the whole page text was read and specific listed claims corrected against primary labels, guidelines, full study text or abstracts. It does not mean every dose, citation, mechanism or clinical recommendation was independently validated. fullTextRead explicitly records reading coverage, while clinicalVerificationComplete remains false for every page. Unresolved pages may be unread or read with unresolved content, as recorded individually. Desmopressin is excluded because the root agent owns its review. SHA256 hashes identify saved text, not clinical certification.

pages.title: Bladder Pain & IC/BPS
scope: Entire page text read; only the listed claims below were source-checked, not every clinical claim.
Corrected false joint AUA/CUA/SUFU attribution and mandatory treatment ladder; summarized AUA2022 removal of numbered tiers and CUA2025 PPS/intravesical positions.
Removed false boxed-warning/annual-screening rule and unqualified best-drug/equivalent-agent claims from navigation cards.
notes: Landing-page treatment claims checked against linked guidance; individual-drug efficacy, dosing and safety live in companions. No blanket clinical sign-off.

pages.title: Intravesical Agents
scope: Entire page text read; only the listed claims below were source-checked, not every clinical claim.
AUA2022 non-tiered positioning and CUA2025 lack of a preferred cocktail; corrected uniform treatment ranking and Hunner steroid-instilling versus lesion-injection distinction.
Rimso-50 50% w/w formulation, 50mL/15-minute/every-two-week label regimen; removed generic cocktail cookbook and unverified universal self-instillation schedule.

Moss2023 full-text protocol and denominator: 83 randomized, 70 completers; paired ICSI responder comparison 63% vs43%, p0.15. Exact two study mixtures and 15-minute dwell, not a preferred prescribing protocol.

Cochrane2020 certainty, Cervigni2017 open-label comparative limits, Corona online2025/issue2026 BPS versus recurrent-UTI endpoint distinction; investigational TRG100 mixed-population and SELP mouse-model context.
notes: Not every legacy mechanism, numerical effect estimate, alternative-agent dose or newer small-trial citation has been independently checked. Study recipes are evidence descriptions; clinical use requires local pharmacy validation.

pages.title: Oral IC/BPS Agents
scope: Entire page text read; only the listed claims below were source-checked, not every clinical claim.
AUA2022 oral options and cyclosporine positioning; CUA2025 conditional recommendation against PPS and insufficient cyclosporine evidence.
ELMIRON label dosing, 3-/6-month reassessment, maculopathy warning (not boxed), retinal monitoring and individualized perioperative timing.

Corrected Foster2010 primary outcome versus exploratory dose subgroup and Cochrane2020 certainty claims; removed automatic cyclosporine efficacy rank/universal trough. Historical CUA2016 hydroxyzine/cyclosporine dose examples explicitly identified.
OE51 already cited; OE52 large Korean retrospective cohort added as safety association, not absolute risk or causal trial proof.
notes: Remaining detailed mechanisms, older individual study values and all product-specific interaction/contraindication statements have not been exhaustively revalidated; edited scope is limited.
